name: version-guard-stale-fails-closed
description: Version-currency guard: when the mock advertises a NEWER collab-cli-v* release than the running build, a bus command (wait) must refuse to run and exit 3 with a STALE banner. Mock serves GET /repos/lbabus-ci/fixture-stale/releases with a tag_name far ahead of the current version (e.g. collab-cli-v99.0.0).
